records.title: ARID: A Deployable Edge AI System for Structured Information Extraction from Industrial Maintenance Work Orders
records.reason: ARID is a deployable Jetson system extracting structured fields from maintenance work orders using 4-bit inference and grammar-constrained decoding; an application system whose inference engineering is use-case specific.

records.title: GNN-LM: Language Modeling based on Global Contexts via GNN
records.reason: GNN-LM augments language modeling with graph aggregation over retrieved neighbor contexts; a modeling architecture for generalization, not an inference system.

records.title: Token Turing Machines
records.reason: Token Turing Machines keep a bounded token memory read/written by a Transformer controller for long visual sequences at bounded per-step cost; an efficient architecture, but a general sequence model rather than an LLM inference system.

records.title: A 2-Dimensional State Space Layer for Spatial Inductive Bias
records.reason: Presents a 2-dimensional state space layer giving visual Transformers spatial inductive bias with efficient parameterization (same work family as the 2-D SSM layer judged from its arXiv abstract); a vision architecture component, not LLM inference.

records.title: LOCOST: State-Space Models for Long Document Abstractive Summarization
records.reason: LOCOST is an SSM encoder-decoder for long-document summarization reporting large inference memory savings over sparse Transformers; efficiency is real, but the contribution is a task-specific summarization architecture.

records.title: Retrieval-of-Thought: Efficient Reasoning via Reusing Thoughts
records.reason: Retrieval-of-Thought reuses prior reasoning steps from a thought graph at inference time, assembling templates that cut output tokens and latency while preserving accuracy; a direct inference-time efficiency method for reasoning models.

records.title: Efficient and Private Federated Learning with Partially Trainable Networks
records.reason: FedPT freezes part of the network during federated learning to cut communication cost across mobile devices; training efficiency for federated learning, not inference.

records.title: Halu-J: Critique-Based Hallucination Judge
records.reason: Halu-J is a critique-based judge for detecting LLM hallucinations against retrieved evidence; an evaluation/detection method with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: START: A Generalized State Space Model with Saliency-Driven Token-Aware Transformation
records.reason: START is an SSM with saliency-driven token transformation for domain generalization in vision; a generalization architecture for image tasks, not inference systems.

records.title: When Importance Sampling Misallocates Credit: Asymmetric Ratios for Outcome-Supervised RL
records.reason: Analyzes how importance-sampling ratios misallocate credit in outcome-supervised RL (GRPO-style) post-training; a training-algorithm study with no inference application.
